description: This Java source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application that demonstrates and allows customization of notifications. It includes UI components for selecting preset notification styles, editing text content, setting priorities, actions, and background options, and manages posting notifications accordingly.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity for managing notification customization and posting in an Android wearable notification sample

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, handlers, and sets up notification presets and listeners.

methods.name: initIncludeLargeIconCheckbox
methods.description: Initializes the large icon inclusion checkbox.

methods.name: initIncludeContentIntentCheckbox
methods.description: Initializes the content intent inclusion checkbox.

methods.name: updateTextEditors
methods.description: Updates editable text fields based on selected preset.

methods.name: updateNotifications
methods.description: Triggers re-posting of notifications with current settings.

methods.name: postNotifications
methods.description: Builds and posts notifications based on current configuration.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Handles delayed message to re-post notifications.
